# Feature orchestration

Use the `orchestrator` custom agent for multi-package features that need intake, a feature brief, task coordination, review, or durable decision capture. It delegates product changes to package specialists and never edits product code itself.

## Local indexes

- [Context index](context/index.md): package ownership, entry points, and repository rules.
- [Business decisions](business/decisions.md): durable product and contract rulings.
- [Feature briefs](features/README.md): planner-owned briefs and task DAGs.
- [Object context](context/objects/README.md): optional concise facts for business objects used across features.

Feature-specific discoveries stay in the corresponding brief. Promote only reusable facts or durable decisions into the indexes. The existing [workflow plan](../../plans/WORKFLOW_PLAN.md) remains a project plan, not an orchestration feature brief.
